data.name: Sunay
data.gender_notes: Sunay is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sunay is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', meaning 'Sun'. It represents the radiance, warmth, and energy of the sun, making it a perfect name for a child who is full of life and vitality. In Hindu culture, the sun is also considered a symbol of power, strength, and illumination. The name Sunay carries the meaning “Sun, Radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sunay usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sunay is a divine name, reflecting the light and energy of the sun. It is believed to bring blessings of health, wealth, and prosperity to the child. In Hinduism, the sun is also considered a symbol of the god Ravi, who is the deity of the sun and the giver of light and life.
data.etymology: Sunay belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sunay total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference:
Sunay was a famous Hindu king who ruled over the Vijayanagara Empire from 1476 to 1490 CE. He is best known for his military prowess and successful campaigns against the Bahmani Sultans.
Context: Vijayanagara Empire

Sunay was an important Hindu philosopher and scholar who lived around the 8th century CE. He is considered one of the pioneers of the Nyaya school of Indian philosophy.
Context: Indian Philosophy
